evidence: The wafers were coated using a custom-built viscous flow reactor, described previously. The dose and purge times were 2 s and 10 s, respectively for each of the precursor steps, resulting in a 24 s cycle time. The reactor chamber temperature was maintained at 100 ◦C and low pressure ( <1 Torr) throughout each deposition process, including a four hour pre-deposition bake time to help remove residual contamination from the wafer surfaces.
